structure.layout: desktop-app frame: Office-style ribbon (tab strip + grouped icon toolbar) across the top, below it a grey start/welcome screen with title, tagline and a two-column grid of link lists (Recent, Help | New Feature, News)

aesthetics.typography: 'Chinese Quote' (Ant Design system font stack, rendering as a sans) for ribbon labels (11px), tab labels and link lists (14px), section labels (20px); Segoe UI for the welcome title (30px/400) and tagline (24px/300).
aesthetics.typeScale: Small-step hierarchy: 30px title, 24px light tagline, 20px section labels, 14px links, 11px ribbon/tab labels, 10px group captions; all regular weight, no bold.

notes: Deliberate imitation of the Microsoft Office ribbon: solid blue (#0072c6) FILE button at far left, HOME/EDIT/ACCOUNT tabs in uppercase 11px, ribbon groups with large dark filled glyph icons over tiny labels and grey group caption bars ('Table', 'Export', 'Page', 'Feedback') separated by thin vertical dividers. The only colour accents are the red speech-bubble Feedback icon and an orange cat avatar next to the username. The welcome screen is unstyled: plain grey background, Ant Design blue (#1890ff) links, emoji in the tagline. No radii, no shadows. Live: FILE opens an Office-style backstage (dark blue left rail + 'Open' list of projects with search), EDIT tab panel is empty, and a 'Data not found' toast shows on load — none of these are in the capture.
